universities.notes: Verified via WebSearch. Integrates DGSE, Nevada Bureau of Mines & Geology (NBMG), and Nevada Seismological Lab (NSL). Key seismology: Christie Rowe (NSL Director), Daniel Trugman, Corné Kreemer, Geoffrey Blewitt (geodesy), Bill Hammond (geodesy).

universities.name: University of Wyoming
universities.department: Department of Geology and Geophysics
universities.notes: Verified via WebSearch. Department head: Mark Clementz. Key geophysics: Subhashis Mallick, Po Chen, Dario Grana, Andrew Parsekian, Bradley Carr (research scientist). Joint appointments with School of Energy Resources.

universities.name: University of New Mexico
universities.department: Department of Earth and Planetary Sciences (EPS)
universities.notes: Verified via WebSearch. Key seismology/geophysics: Brandon Schmandt (seismology, geophysics), Eric Lindsey (assistant professor), Lindsay Lowe Worthington (associate professor). Housed primarily in Northrop Hall.

universities.name: University of Rhode Island
universities.department: Graduate School of Oceanography (GSO)
universities.notes: Verified via WebSearch. Faculty organized by discipline: Biological Oceanography, Physical Oceanography, Marine Geology & Geophysics, Chemical Oceanography. Key marine geology/geophysics: Yang Shen, Matt Wei.

universities.name: University of South Carolina
universities.department: School of the Earth, Ocean and Environment (SEOE)
universities.notes: Verified via WebSearch. Comprehensive directory with search/filter. SEOE includes Geological Sciences and Marine Sciences programs. Director: Gene Yogodzinski.

universities.name: Dalhousie University
universities.department: Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences / Department of Oceanography
universities.department_zh: 地球与环境科学系 / 海洋学系
universities.notes: Verified via WebSearch. Two separate departments: Earth & Environmental Sciences (formerly Earth Sciences, merged with Environmental Science in 2019) and Oceanography. Earth Sciences key geophysics: Mladen Nedimovic (marine geophysics, Killam Professor). Oceanography page: dal.ca/faculty/science/oceanography/people.html. Earth Sciences: Isabelle Coutand, Djordje Grujic (thermochronology).

universities.name: UNAM, Instituto de Geofísica
universities.department: Instituto de Geofísica
universities.notes: Verified via WebSearch. National autonomous university institute. Departments: Sismología, Vulcanología, Geodesia Satelital, Paleomagnetismo, Ciencias Espaciales. Key seismologists: Víctor Manuel Cruz-Atienza (earthquake source dynamics, Guerrero gap), Arturo Iglesias. Researchers at usuarios.geofisica.unam.mx. /personal-academico/ returned 404.

universities.name: NTU - Earth Observatory of Singapore (EOS)
universities.department: Earth Observatory of Singapore (EOS) / Asian School of the Environment
universities.department_zh: 新加坡地球观测站 / 亚洲环境学院
universities.notes: EOS is NTU's primary earth-science research institute. Faculty hold joint appointments with the Asian School of the Environment (ASE). The Our People page lists Director, PIs, Research Fellows, PhD students, and Administration.

universities.name: NUS - Department of Geography
universities.department: Department of Geography, Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences
universities.notes: NUS does not have a dedicated 'Earth Sciences' department. Earth-science research (physical geography, tropical environmental change, fluvial geomorphology, climate) is housed in the Department of Geography. QS Geography ranked 6th globally (2025).

universities.name: HKU - Department of Earth Sciences
universities.department: Department of Earth Sciences (also Dept. of Earth & Planetary Sciences)
universities.notes: Faculty includes experts in Precambrian geology, metamorphic petrology, hydrogeology, paleoclimate, planetary geology, and engineering geology. Strong in solid-Earth geochemistry and tectonics.

universities.name: CUHK - Earth & Environmental Sciences
universities.department: Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences
universities.notes: Seismology faculty include Prof. YANG Hongfeng (earthquake seismology) and Prof. TAN Yen Joe (earthquake seismology, volcanology). Also strong in atmospheric science, geophysics, and oceanography.

universities.name: HKUST - Department of Ocean Science
universities.department: Department of Ocean Science (OCES), School of Science
universities.notes: Established 2018. Covers physical oceanography, marine biogeochemistry, marine biology, ocean-atmosphere interaction, and climate dynamics. Led by Prof. Jianping GAN. Related to HKUST(GZ) EOAS Thrust.

universities.name: University of Tokyo - Earth & Planetary Science
universities.department: Department of Earth and Planetary Science, Graduate School of Science
universities.notes: Japan's top earth-science department. Faculty organized into core/cooperative/collaborative chairs covering atmosphere-ocean, space-planetary, solid-Earth, and geobiosphere science. Includes seismologist Prof. Satoshi Ide. Cooperative chairs include Earthquake Research Institute (ERI).

universities.name: Kyoto University - Geophysics
universities.department: Department of Geophysics, Graduate School of Science
universities.notes: Four research groups: Physics of the Solid Earth, Hydrospheric Physics, Atmospheric Physics, Solar Planetary Electrodynamics. Faculty also from affiliated institutes (DPRI, Institute for Geothermal Sciences). Japanese-language faculty page. English overview: https://sci.kyoto-u.ac.jp/en/divisions/earth-planet/geophys

universities.name: Tohoku University - Geophysics / Seismology
universities.department: Research Center for Prediction of Earthquakes and Volcanic Eruptions, Graduate School of Science
universities.department_zh: 地震・噴火予知研究観測センター
universities.notes: Japan's leading seismology research center, greatly expanded after the 2011 Tohoku earthquake. Faculty include Prof. Dapeng Zhao (seismic tomography, 2024 AGU Fellow), Prof. Ryota Hino (Director), and experts in earthquake source physics, crustal deformation, and volcanology.

universities.name: Peking University - Geophysics
universities.department: School of Earth and Space Sciences (SESS)
universities.notes: China's top geophysics program. Faculty A-Z covers Geophysics, Space Physics, Geochemistry, Mineral Sciences, Remote Sensing, etc. Geophysics professors include Huang Qinghua, Zhou Shiyong, Chen Yongshun, and many others. Also see Institute of Theoretical and Applied Geophysics at geophy.pku.edu.cn.

universities.name: USTC - Earth & Space Sciences
universities.department: School of Earth and Space Sciences
universities.notes: Top-tier Chinese earth-science school. 115 faculty/staff including 44 professors and 32 associate professors. The People page covers Solid Geophysics faculty with names, titles, and emails. Executive Dean: Prof. Chen Xiaofei (seismologist). Also covers Space Physics, Atmospheric Science, and Geochemistry.

universities.name: China University of Geosciences (Wuhan) - Geophysics
universities.department: School of Geophysics and Geomatics (地空学院)
universities.department_zh: 地球物理与空间信息学院
universities.notes: One of China's two major geoscience universities. Faculty page in Chinese. Faculty organized into Applied Geophysics, Solid Earth Geophysics, Geo-information Science & Technology, and Experimental Teaching Center. 114 faculty/staff with 36 professors.

universities.name: Seoul National University - Earth & Environmental Sciences
universities.department: School of Earth and Environmental Sciences (SEES)
universities.notes: Korea's leading earth-science school. 37 full-time faculty across three broad majors: Atmospheric Science, Earth System Science, and Oceanography. 10 research groups. Faculty include Prof. Rhie Junkee (seismology), Prof. Kim Duk-Jin (remote sensing/geophysics).

universities.name: National Taiwan University - Geosciences
universities.department: Department of Geosciences, College of Science
universities.notes: Taiwan's premier geoscience department. 22+ full-time faculty covering seismology, earthquake geology, active tectonics, geophysics, petrology, paleoclimate, and geochemistry. Strong seismology group due to Taiwan's tectonic setting. Site http://web.gl.ntu.edu.tw (HTTP only, may be intermittently unreachable — verified via web search and member CVs).
